item.description:
Add MCPs from a GitHub link

Paste a repository link in Add MCP. FullHouse checks whether its npm package is a matching MCP server, pins the package version, and prepares a configuration to review. Changes to your tools still go through Queue → Review → Apply.

New

  • Ask local Codex about other MCP setups — When direct npm import is unavailable, you can ask local Codex to inspect a snapshot of the repository's documentation and manifests without running its code. FullHouse validates supported PyPI, Docker, and HTTPS proposals before letting you queue them. Source builds and unsupported commands remain manual setup.
